Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production PNG for a pixel-art landscape game.
Input image 1 is a STYLE AND COLOR REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target. Match its warm storybook pixel-art world, readable stepped silhouettes, amber lantern light, cream highlights, saturated natural colors. Generate ONLY the specified isolated asset on genuinely transparent alpha, with ample transparent padding. No scene, UI, lettering, frame border, grid lines, checkerboard, watermark, or background. Pixel-art forms use deliberate aligned square pixels, no painterly texture.
Produce a landscape 4:3 spritesheet with EXACTLY EIGHT animation frames in FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows. No gutters or outer margins beyond padding INSIDE each equal cell. All frames have the same subject, size, camera, anatomy, proportions and anchor position. Chronological row-major order: top row frames 0–3, bottom row 4–7. Keep all content of each frame fully inside its own cell with generous alpha padding; no pixels crossing cell boundaries. Frame 7 transitions smoothly to frame 0. No drawn grid, numbers or labels.
Subject: ONE slender dark-gold fairy-light cord hanging in a shallow curved scallop, bearing seven tiny warm amber bulbs and two small four-point golden star lights, like the glowing garland strung among the reference tree branches. It is one horizontally wide complete garland, duplicated as eight phases. Its cord and bulb placements remain rigid and identical; only the brightness and small translucent halos of individual bulbs twinkle in staggered phases, with a cream-yellow pixel center and amber glow. Keep the garland cord thin and the glow subtle, leave space between lights. This is a small overlay to drape around branches, NOT a tree or a cutout of the scene. No leaves, branches, trunk, lanterns, background or large opaque yellow clouds.
